_doc: Ambient traffic on the roads that are NOT the downtown grid. traffic.gd reads data/world/atlas.json (D-066) at setup, takes every road of class 'street', and drives it as a KIND_SPUR polyline: cars ride lane_offset metres right of the centreline, so one polyline carries both directions; corners are taken with the grid's own arc radii; each end U-turns unless it meets a grid lane it can merge straight onto. Every key here is optional — traffic.gd's consts are the fallbacks. 'caps' and 'lanes' override spur_cap and lane_offset for one road, keyed by its atlas name.
_lanes_doc: lane_offset is half the road: 3.5 suits Juárez Boulevard's 12 m of asphalt (cedar_cliff.BLVD_W), 2.0 suits the 8 m side and back streets, where a 3.5 m lane would hang a wheel off the edge.
